about: Questions our buyers ask, in the words a small business owner would type to an AI assistant. Rows marked backlog are the real public questions in seo/BACKLOG.md, reworded only enough to name the city the product covers; rows marked intent are the direct shopping question for the product. The radar run asks each one weekly (tools/ai_visibility.py). Add a row when a new product is wired (tools/product_wire.py checks the product's question pages, the radar run adds its questions here).
